snapshotMonth.title: Snapshot month
snapshotMonth.description: Format YYYY-MM, or 'latest' to auto-detect the current Companies House snapshot (recommended, since old snapshots are removed monthly).

incorporatedSince.title: Incorporated since
incorporatedSince.description: Only include companies incorporated on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

incorporatedBefore.title: Incorporated before
incorporatedBefore.description: Only include companies incorporated on/before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

sicCodePrefixes.title: SIC code prefixes
sicCodePrefixes.description: Match if the company's SIC code starts with any of these, e.g. 56101

sicKeywords.title: SIC keyword match
sicKeywords.description: Match if the company's SIC description text contains any of these words, e.g. Restaurant

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: e.g. ENGLAND, UNITED KINGDOM, GREAT BRITAIN

nameContains.title: Name contains
nameContains.description: Only include companies whose name contains this text (case-insensitive).

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Stop once this many matching companies have been found.

logEveryNRows.title: Log progress every N rows
logEveryNRows.description: How often to log progress while scanning the snapshot, in number of rows.

enrichWithOfficers.title: Enrich with officer and PSC names
enrichWithOfficers.description: If true, fetches director/officer names and persons with significant control (beneficial owners) for each matched company via the Companies House API. Requires CH_API_KEY environment variable to be set.

enrichWithPhone.title: Enrich with phone number (Google Places)
enrichWithPhone.description: If true, looks up each matched company on Google Places by name and post town, and attaches phone number and website if found. Requires GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY environment variable to be set. Coverage varies, not every small business has a Google listing.
